nodes.name: Fetch PR Diff
nodes.notes: Reads GITHUB_TOKEN from .env. No n8n credential setup required.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ contents: [{ parts: [{ text: `Review this code diff. Focus on:
1. Security vulnerabilities (injection, auth bypass, secrets exposure)
2. Performance issues (N+1 queries, unnecessary allocations)
3. Logic errors (off-by-one, null handling, race conditions)
4. Convention violations (naming, structure)

Only flag issues you're confident about. No false positives.
Respond as markdown with findings. If no issues, say 'No issues found.'

Diff (chunk ${$json.chunk_index + 1}/${$json.total_chunks}):
\`\`\`diff
${$json.chunk.slice(0, 12000)}
\`\`\`` }] }] }) }}
